protocol.reuse: Declared independent Step18 pairs (default all16); 10 scored generations, nine inherited transitions, entire frozen generation10 birth cohort. No test-selected champions, retraining, or outcome-based seed removal. This extends rather than independently replicates Step18 training.
protocol.neutral: 20 uniformly random parents from all100 completed lifetimes, including early deaths, five children each; same mutation masks, Gaussian draws, slot shuffles, bodies, food, and training evaluations as fitness selection. No survival-dependent eligibility in this counterfactual baseline.
protocol.physical_controls: All100 actors, 60pixels/s, 5energy/s, capacity100, initialenergy100, food20, turn<=90degrees/s, sight160, identical body/lifespan/food starts. Random/greedy use frozen founder arrays only as unused placeholders; genetic diversity is not attributed to these policies.
protocol.random: Uniform turn rates[-90,90]degrees/s held for random .75–2s intervals; ignores food. Greedy uses the same random fallback when no food is detected, otherwise turns toward nearest detected pellet with the same turn limit and no overshoot.
protocol.food: Existing World immediate replenishment to standing stock, with deterministic seeded proposals and rejection around current actors. Starts and rules match; subsequent pellet placements may differ as paths/eating diverge. No hazards, seasons, physical-trait evolution, social interactions, or continuous reproduction in these tests.
protocol.diagnostics: Ancestral brains measure net adaptation on matched unseen layouts. Hidden conditions zero only the three food inputs in frozen evolved/neutral brains; never train/test-select with hidden inputs. Barren omits redundant hidden conditions because all truthful food signals are already zero.
protocol.analysis_unit: Independent training seed pair. Average repeats within seed/environment/condition before inference; never treat descendants, lifetimes, repeats, or environments as independent training replicates.
protocol.primary_family: 45 two-sided exact paired sign tests: evolved-minus-random/greedy/neutral for fitness, meals, and 60-second survival in all five environments; Holm correction over all45. Sign ties abs<=1e-10.
protocol.secondary_family: 21 exploratory two-sided sign tests with separate Holm correction: evolved/neutral-minus-founder fitness (10); evolved food-sensor fitness loss and evolved-minus-neutral sensor-loss interaction in four food environments (8); final full/steering genetic RMS and effective founder-family selection-minus-neutral differences (3). Other diagnostic endpoints and transfer effects descriptive.
protocol.intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap of independent seed means/pairs,20000 resamples, fixed namespace-derived seeds; approximate pointwise intervals, not simultaneous familywise intervals. 2 repeats average test-environment randomness; uncertainty conditional on original training sample.
protocol.decision: Higher/lower requires Holm p<.05 plus paired mean CI excluding zero in the same direction. Inconclusive is not equivalence. Sign test evaluates equal win/loss probability among non-ties, not mean equality; CIs estimate mean effect separately.
protocol.adaptation: Held-out evolved/neutral minus frozen original founder brains; genetic change during nine inherited transitions plus training trajectories. No within-test adaptation or new training in shifted environments.
protocol.diversity: All100 genomes each training generation reconstructed from recorded inheritance/mutation. Standardized RMS unordered-pair distance: full90 parameters and steering81 (exclude unused throttle column/bias). Weights scaled by1/sqrt8 and biases by.1, divide by sqrt(parametercount). Effective genealogical founder families=exp Shannon; distinct genomes by exact hash. Genetic distance is coordinate-dependent, not a functional/speciation measure.
protocol.failure_reporting: All nonpositive evolved-minus-control seed-mean fitness cases for each baseline/environment, plus complete starvation/zero-meal rates. All scheduled trials retained, including barren ties; no post-result tuning or early stopping.
